column1: # Hand-curated recipes. Columns: result, IDS, optional gloss.
# Any character listed here ignores its dictionary decomposition, so this file
# both fills in atoms the dictionary leaves undecomposed (人, 女, 心 ...) and
# corrects decompositions that collide or read badly. List a character on
# several rows to give it several recipes. Stroke-level recipes approximate
# stroke order and shape; they are game design, not etymology.
# Center drops try overlaid/enclosing layouts in order ⿴⿵⿶⿷⿸⿹⿺⿻, so two
# recipes that share strokes but differ in layout are found one after another.
# Traditional core components (traditional mode has no 马/鸟/页/门/车 to lean on)
